title: What's New in Sustainability: Sustainability Journals Approval (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and motivation for sustainability journal approvals

features.name: Sustainability journal approvals
features.description: Enables approval workflow processes for sustainability journal batches to improve compliance and control for companies required to report under CSRD or similar regulations.
caveats: Approval applies to entire batch only, not per individual line
Uses existing standard Business Central approval workflow setup

features.name: Sustainability journal batch approval workflow template
features.description: New workflow template for sustainability journal batch approvals that leverages existing Business Central approval workflow functionality without custom development.
caveats: Operates the same as all other approval workflows in Business Central

features.name: Approval request control for sustainability journal
features.description: Users can send or cancel approval requests for sustainability journal batches with flexible workflow management consistent with other Business Central approval processes.
caveats: Only available for entire batches, not individual lines

quotes.text: for bigger companies who need to report they would like to have this approval process to improve compliance and control
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary business driver for adding approval workflow to sustainability journals

quotes.text: you can run from sustainability journal approval only for one batch. So not per line, only for whole batch
quotes.why_it_matters: States an important limitation of the feature

quotes.text: user can choose to send approval request or to cancel approval request
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes user options and confirms consistency with other approval workflows
